professionalSummary.text: Experienced DevOps Engineer with expertise in infrastructure as code, monitoring, and deployment processes for settlement systems.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the Terraform modules and Helm charts for the settlement-file service's UAT and performance-test clusters, with separate state files per environment.

experienceHighlights.text: Developed Terraform modules and Helm charts for settlement-file service clusters in UAT and performance-test environments.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the Terraform modules and Helm charts for the settlement-file service's UAT and performance-test clusters, with separate state files per environment.

experienceHighlights.text: Built Grafana dashboards and alert rules for settlement-file service health metrics in pre-production environment.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built Grafana dashboards and alert rules for the settlement-file service in the pre-production environment, covering queue depth, file-generation latency and failed transfers, and tuned the alert thresholds during the performance tests.

experienceHighlights.text: Conducted fault-injection tests in performance-test cluster to evaluate system resilience during simulated end-of-day runs.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran fault-injection tests in the performance-test cluster, killing pods and throttling the database link during simulated end-of-day runs, and wrote up the recovery times.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed release handovers to client bank's release management team for production deployments, including change approvals and release window support.
experienceHighlights.witness: Handed each release candidate to the client bank's release management team, which held production change approval and carried out the deployments; answered that team's questions during each release window.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented operational procedures for settlement-file service, including alerts, dependencies, and restart steps for production support team.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the operational handover document for the settlement-file service, describing its alerts, dependencies and restart steps for the production support team, which signed it off at handover.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Performance-test report for settlement-file service showing throughput at 1x, 2x, and 3x expected end-of-day volume with recovery times from fault-injection tests.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the performance-test report for the settlement-file service, with throughput at one, two and three times the expected end-of-day volume in the performance-test cluster and the recovery times from the fault-injection runs.

skills.text: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) with certificate valid until 2027.
skills.witness: HR verification note: the candidate's Certified Kubernetes Administrator certificate was checked on the issuer's certificate verification page and is shown as valid until 2027, with the holder's name matching the candidate's.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's work with Terraform/Helm in UAT/performance-test environments, Grafana dashboards in pre-production, fault-injection testing, release handovers to client bank's release management team, and CKA certification. The materials do not establish production deployment, regulated environment operation, or direct on-call duty.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required due to partial evidence for production deployment and on-call duties.

evidence.text: Wrote the Terraform modules and Helm charts for the settlement-file service's UAT and performance-test clusters, with separate state files per environment.
evidence.notes: UAT and performance-test environments, not production

evidence.text: Built Grafana dashboards and alert rules for the settlement-file service in the pre-production environment, covering queue depth, file-generation latency and failed transfers, and tuned the alert thresholds during the performance tests.

Handed each release candidate to the client bank's release management team, which held production change approval and carried out the deployments; answered that team's questions during each release window.
evidence.notes: Client bank's release management team handled production deployments, not the candidate

evidence.text: Wrote the operational handover document for the settlement-file service, describing its alerts, dependencies and restart steps for the production support team, which signed it off at handover.
evidence.notes: Handover document created, but not direct operation in production

evidence.text: Ran fault-injection tests in the performance-test cluster, killing pods and throttling the database link during simulated end-of-day runs, and wrote up the recovery times.

Work sample: the performance-test report for the settlement-file service, with throughput at one, two and three times the expected end-of-day volume in the performance-test cluster and the recovery times from the fault-injection runs.

HR verification note: the candidate's Certified Kubernetes Administrator certificate was checked on the issuer's certificate verification page and is shown as valid until 2027, with the holder's name matching the candidate's.

supportedClaims.claim: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) with certificate valid until 2027.
supportedClaims.witness: HR verification note: the candidate's Certified Kubernetes Administrator certificate was checked on the issuer's certificate verification page and is shown as valid until 2027, with the holder's name matching the candidate's.

unsupportedClaims.claim: The candidate deployed and operated services in a regulated production environment.
unsupportedClaims.reason: Materials state client bank's release management team carried out deployments and held change approval, not the candidate.
unsupportedClaims.requiredFollowUp: Ask for confirmation of direct production deployment and operation responsibilities.

unsupportedClaims.claim: The candidate has direct on-call duty for production services.
unsupportedClaims.reason: Materials mention handover to production support team but do not establish candidate's on-call role.
unsupportedClaims.requiredFollowUp: Ask about candidate's role in production on-call rota.

missingEvidenceGaps.gap: Direct operation in regulated production environment, including on-call duty.

interviewSignalRisks.text: the candidate described the settlement-file service as 'live since March' and said the client bank's release manager had told the candidate that it now produces the end-of-day settlement file for every branch.
interviewSignalRisks.recommendedHandling: Ask for concrete evidence of the service being 'live' and the client bank's release manager's statement.

followUpQuestions.question: Can you describe your direct responsibilities for operating the settlement-file service in the production environment, including any on-call duties?
followUpQuestions.evidenceTarget: Direct production operation and on-call duty

followUpQuestions.question: What is the difference between your Terraform work in UAT/performance-test environments and production environments?
How do the Grafana dashboards you built in pre-production differ from those used in production?
Have you conducted resilience tests in a production environment, and if so, what was the process for approval and execution?

humanReviewChecklist: Verify production deployment and operation responsibilities
Confirm on-call duty for production services
Validate infrastructure as code in production environment
Confirm dashboard and alert deployment in production
Confirm resilience testing in production environment
hiringEvidencePacket.auditSummary: The materials establish the candidate's work with Terraform/Helm in UAT/performance-test environments, Grafana dashboards in pre-production, fault-injection testing, release handovers to client bank's release management team, and CKA certification. The materials do not establish production deployment, regulated environment operation, or direct on-call duty. All claims are sourced, and subjective content is flagged for review.
limitations: Materials do not establish production deployment or operation
Materials do not establish direct on-call duty
